Bench claims: Tensile modulus, bend radius, encapsulation behavior, impedance, cyclic durability, moisture uptake
Preclinical claims: Tissue response in a defined model, mechanical stability, chronic impedance, signal retention
Clinical claims: Safety and functional utility only for the exact device/configuration and follow-up interval studied
Review-level claims: General discussion of flexibility, mismatch reduction, degradation concerns
Main translation gap: Long-duration reliability, encapsulation, fatigue failure, manufacturability, interface stability

Bench claims: Conductivity, impedance reduction, coating adhesion, charge-transfer behavior, accelerated aging
Preclinical claims: Coating integrity, signal quality, inflammatory response, delamination/degradation in model conditions
Clinical claims: Device-specific safety and performance evidence under governed clinical protocol
Review-level claims: Potential for lower impedance and improved interface properties, with degradation caveats
Main translation gap: Chronic delamination, electrochemical aging, batch reproducibility, long-term stability

Bench claims: Sheet resistance, surface morphology, electrochemical characteristics, flexibility, coating robustness
Preclinical claims: Biocompatibility and stability in the tested model, interface signal performance
Clinical claims: Only exact application-specific evidence, not class-wide safety
Review-level claims: Broad potential for conductive/flexible interfaces with material-specific risk
Main translation gap: Manufacturing consistency, impurities, long-term biological response, regulatory evidence

Bench claims: Conductivity, thickness, adhesion, flex fatigue, corrosion behavior, microfabrication yield
Preclinical claims: Durability, tissue interaction, recording/stimulation behavior in defined models
Clinical claims: Exact implant/device clinical performance and safety data only
Review-level claims: Established relevance of thin-film approaches for microfabricated interfaces
Main translation gap: Crack propagation, corrosion, delamination, packaging, chronic fatigue under realistic movement

Bench claims: Modulus matching, hydration, diffusion, swelling, conductivity where applicable
Preclinical claims: Model-specific biocompatibility, mechanical integration, short/medium-term stability
Clinical claims: Exact hydrogel/device configuration evidence under clinical governance

Main translation gap: Dehydration, swelling, fracture, electrical stability, packaging, sterilization, long-term attachment
